ns2:course.label: Introduction to Biophysics
ns2:course.description: Topics include equilibrium thermodynamics, kinetics, and quantum mechanics with applications to biological and chemical systems. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: MCB 354 or MCB 450, or equivalent, or consent of instructor.
